company.name: Syndio
company.shortDescription: Syndio is a technology company that helps companies measure, achieve, and sustain workplace equity.
company.description:
Syndio is a technology company that helps companies measure, achieve, and sustain workplace equity.

Syndio’s mission is to empower employers to eradicate unlawful pay disparities due to gender, race, and ethnicity and make ongoing compensation decisions that are consistent and equitable. Syndio customers drastically reduce legal risk, save millions in ongoing remediation, and create a positive brand reputation, which helps attract and retain top talent at every level of the business. Over time, we help companies close their pay gap. Syndio is proud to partner with brands – including Salesforce, Nordstrom, General Mills, Nerdwallet, Match Group and many more – who are leading the way in equity and setting the standard for workplace fairness.

Syndio pay equity analysis software helps companies quickly analyze and resolve pay gaps, empowering them to do the right thing while doing what’s best for their business. The company license software to companies that are serious about equal pay and help them find and fix pay equity issues, and stay in compliance over time.

aiResearchSummary.text: Syndio is researching and developing methods and systems for analyzing and determining the impact of selected pay policies on groups of employees, as described in 'Dynamically evaluating the consistency, bias, legitimacy, or intended effects.' The focus is on computer-implemented approaches to assess consistency, bias, and legitimacy in workplace equity, supporting organizations in evaluating the effects of their compensation strategies.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series C round raised $50,000,000, or 59.93% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $6,250,000 to $369,913,467, a 59.19x increase.
